technical.summary: IBM shows strong directional bias with price above all major moving averages and trending ADX, but extreme overbought conditions across RSI(9/14), Stochastic, and Williams %R with no fresh momentum crossovers create high pullback risk and poor swing entry timing.

fundamental.summary: IBM shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 86 days present material risk with no offsetting fundamental or smart money support.

sentiment.summary: Mixed signals: Congressional activity is minimal and non-directional; market fear (36/100) presents contrarian opportunity, but lack of news data and weak insider conviction limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (282.6) indicates extreme market stress, FOMC event in 2 days adds binary risk, and macro score of -7 reflects deeply unfavourable conditions; earnings in 86 days provides some buffer but does not offset current environment severity.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above all major moving averages with trending ADX (34) and market fear at 36/100 creates contrarian opportunity for mean-reversion bounce.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme overbought conditions across RSI(9/14), Stochastic K at 96, and Williams %R with zero momentum confirmation, combined with crisis-level VIX, inverted yield curve, FOMC event in 2 days, and high earnings risk in 86 days, create exhaustion setup with severe macro headwinds.

decision.entry_rationale: IBM exhibits extreme overbought conditions across all momentum indicators with zero fresh entry triggers, and macro environment (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, FOMC in 2 days) creates binary risk that outweighs contrarian opportunity from market fear.
decision.primary_risk: Exhaustion-driven pullback triggered by FOMC event in 2 days or earnings volatility in 86 days, with no momentum confirmation to support current price levels in crisis-level macro conditions.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case
decision.portfolio_note: Existing IBM position and 48 open Information Technology positions create sector concentration; avoid adding to already-exposed portfolio in unfavourable macro environment.
